resources.string: Calibrate the Touch Screen if it is not responding correctly to the stylus.
Touch the center of the mark with the stylus.\n\nTouch it as accurately as possible.
The Touch Screen could not be calibrated.\n\nTouch the center of each mark as accurately as possible, then try again.
Touch the screen to check the calibration.\n\nIf the mark does not appear where you touch, tap Retry.
The Touch Screen has been calibrated.
